popupCloseWarning.message: 拡張機能の制限により、入力したデータはポップアップを閉じると消えます。データを残したい場合は、$LINK$。
popupCloseWarning.description: Warning above a tool opened inside the extension popup. First sentence: what the user enters disappears when the popup closes, because of what browser extensions can do; second: opening the tool in a new tab keeps it, with $LINK$ standing for that action as a link (popupCloseWarningLink). Simple everyday words

link.example: このツールを新しいタブで開いてください

popupCloseWarningLink.message: このツールを新しいタブで開いてください
popupCloseWarningLink.description: Link inside the warning above a tool opened in the popup (it replaces $LINK$ in popupCloseWarning, so it must fit that sentence): opens the tool on the website in a new browser tab

dontShowAgain.description: Button in the warning above a tool opened in the popup that turns the warning off for good
